light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Place this same man in a new place. The place is a real, messy home garage-workshop of a working-class house in Latin America: concrete floor with old stains and cement dust, a wooden workbench covered in tools, tins, rags and offcuts, a pegboard with hanging tools, stacked plastic buckets, a bicycle leaning on the wall, bare painted brick walls with damp patches, the wide garage door on the left open to the street. He is the man of the reference photo — same face, same dark curly hair, same short salt-and-pepper beard — wearing a faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, stained with paint and dust, and a worn brown leather apron over it. The two halves of an old white porcelain toilet sawn in half lengthwise: the flat cut face shows the inside of the curved trap channel lined with a thick, rough, layered crust of yellow-brown and grey limescale, like stone, narrowing the passage to less than half lie on the workbench under the fluorescent tube; he stands behind the bench, both hands resting on the edge, looking at the camera, relaxed, late afternoon. Medium shot, waist-up. clips.text: ¿Cómo hacer que no vuelva? Una vez por semana, antes de dormir, un vaso de vinagre en la taza, y a la mañana, descargas.
clips.action: He holds up a plain glass of vinegar, then mimes pouring it and sleeping with his hands against his cheek, talking to the camera.

clips.text: Y el cepillo, pásalo también por debajo del borde, no sólo por la taza. Ahí empieza todo, y es donde nadie mira.
clips.action: He takes a toilet brush from the bench and mimes brushing under the rim of the cut toilet half, talking to the camera.

clips.text: Si tu agua es muy dura, lo vas a notar en la ducha y en el hervidor también. Ahí conviene repetir esto cada pocos meses.
clips.action: He puts the brush down and talks to the camera, gesturing toward the house behind the garage.

clips.text: ¿Cómo saber si tu agua es dura? Mira el vidrio de la ducha. Si queda con manchas blancas que no salen con jabón, eso es cal.
clips.action: He holds up a small piece of glass with white water spots on it, turning it to the light, talking to the camera.

clips.text: Lo de la curva lo guardé para el final porque fue lo que más me sorprendió cuando lo abrí. Y lo vas a entender enseguida.
clips.action: He puts the glass down, pulls the cut toilet half toward him on the bench and looks at the camera with a small smile.

clips.text: Y te había prometido lo de la curva de abajo. Mira esto. Aquí, en el codo más bajo, la costra no es pareja.
clips.action: He points the flashlight into the lowest bend of the cut trap channel, talking to the camera.

clips.text: Hace un escalón. Un borde duro, filoso, que sobresale. Justo ahí se engancha el papel, y detrás se va juntando todo lo demás.
clips.action: The flashlight beam moves over the sharp crust ridge in the bottom bend and reveals paper caught behind it.

clips.text: Por eso hay inodoros que se tapan con muy poco papel. No es el papel. Es este escalón, que ningún cepillo alcanza.
clips.action: He runs his finger along the ridge in the bend and shakes his head, talking to the camera.

clips.text: Y ahí sólo llega una cosa: el ácido, con el agua bien bajada, y con tiempo. Por eso el primer paso es el más importante de todos.
clips.action: He taps the bench with his finger three times as he talks to the camera, firm.

clips.text: Y si la línea te vuelve en pocas semanas, revisa la mochila, que ya te mostré la prueba del colorante. Casi siempre es eso.
clips.action: He mimes lifting a tank lid and adding drops with his fingers, then nods to the camera.

clips.text: Bueno… me callo. Pero el muriático lo sigo usando, ¿eh?
clips.action: The neighbour raises his hands in surrender with a half smile and says his line, then points a finger jokingly; the presenter listens.

clips.text: Úsalo, pero diluido y sin cloro cerca. Y tú, si esto te sirvió, cuéntame en los comentarios cómo está la línea de tu inodoro.
clips.action: He laughs toward the neighbour off-frame on the left, then turns to the camera and talks, friendly.

clips.text: Y si quieres tener estos arreglos a mano, con materiales y medidas, la colección está en el enlace de abajo. Nos vemos en el próximo.
